passages.title: Webhook verification and correlation
passages.text: Verify the original Razorpay Test Mode payload before deriving provider correlation. Resolve the correlation through the authoritative PostgreSQL mapping; a caller-supplied case identifier cannot establish attachment authority. Invalid or unresolved deliveries are quarantined.

passages.title: Authority and workflow ownership
passages.text: PostgreSQL owns business state and audit history. n8n owns durable orchestration for the hosted incident-analysis handoff. Redpanda transports versioned events, Neo4j is rebuildable, and Redis is coordination only.

passages.title: Action safety boundary
passages.text: The model may analyze evidence and produce typed proposals only. Approvals, deterministic policy, the isolated idempotent Action Gateway, verification, and append-only audit are required before any merchant-controlled side effect. Financial actions remain disabled by default.

passages.title: Replay and evaluation labels
passages.text: Replay is read-only and cannot be presented as live merchant execution. Evaluation reports include dataset, policy, model, and execution provenance; synthetic outcomes are not production fraud performance.

passages.title: Help assistant boundary
passages.text: The help assistant answers reviewed documentation questions only. It has no case lookup, database, shell, web browsing, arbitrary network, or business-action tools, and it returns an explicit unavailable or insufficient-evidence status when the bounded model path cannot answer.
